limitations: Whole-formulation allocation does not establish independent physical acquisitions or batches
Distinct P5 curves share one formulation and stay in one partition; duplicated controls are counted only once
Table temperatures differ and no justified perturbation distribution is adopted
Curator-only retrospective reconstruction; source contains historically exposed responses; no evaluator vault access or test-target export

partition_provenance.allocation: NS and NG fixed confirmation; compact-v2 opaque-formulation hash selects two dev groups from remaining six. Original leave-formulation-out metadata are not the compact train/dev split.

policy.calibration: Observed CoF at0.2 and500mm/s of each curve; strictly outside all12 scored0.28–10mm/s rows
policy.duplicates: Frozen aliases among all 25-row curves; changed duplicates reject reconstruction rather than select a new cohort
policy.lineage: Exact CSV member, one-based row/column and both calibration cell coordinates
policy.measurement: Published CoF curves in measured speed coordinates; no native force/torque acquisition or summary variability used as target
policy.predictors: Speed, two measured endpoint calibrations and concentration; no condition ID, scored response, fitted curve or author summary bars

reference_parser_provenance.reuse: Independently reimplemented only measurement/identity specification; no fitted model, evaluator or runtime copied
